book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Pipul sing dijan song wen olabat king git merrit
Song blanga det femili blanga Kora wen dubala laigim gija.

content.text: Ola gudwan wed kamat langa main hed wen mi meigimbat dijan song blanga det king.
Main tang im redibala blanga sing dijan, jis laik det pensul redibala blanga det men hu oldei raidimdan stori brabli gudwei.
Haibala king, nobodi jidan laik yu.
Yu tok brabli gudwei.
God bin oldei kain langa yu.
Strongbala king, yu pudumon yu bigwan naif.
Haibalawan, yu luk gudwan.
Yu kipgon garram yu haibala pawa blanga win blanga det trubalawei en blanga jadjim raitwei.
Blanga yu strongbala pawa garra meigim yu win olataim.
Larram ola brabli shapwan erro blanga yu hitim detlot hat blanga yu enamimob,
en yu bidim olabat.
Det kantri God bin gibit yu blanga jidan bos garra jidan olagijawan.
Yu jidan bos langa yu pipul olabat en yu gibit olabat feyago.
Yu laigim ola rait ting en yu nomo laigim ola nogud ting.
Blanga tharran na det God blanga yu bin pikimat yu, en imbin meigim yu jidan gudbinjiwei olataim.
Imbin gibit yu mowa brom ola najalot king.
Det gudsmelwan medisin brom mera, elos en kasha jidan langa yu klos,
en detlot hu plei myusik, plei blanga yu insaid langa ola bigwan haus weya deibin meigim purdiwan garram boun blanga elafen.
Ola doda blanga ola king jidan deya garram ola najalot gel,
en det gel weya yu garra merrit im jandap langa det raidensaid blanga yu speshalwan tjeya,
en im werrimbat olkain ting weya deibin meigimbat garram brabli gudwan gol.
Main gel, yu lisin langa wanim ai garra tok.
Yu nomo teiknodis langa yu pipulmob en yu femilimob.
Yu brabli purdiwan, en tharran na garra meigim det king wandim yu brabli.
Im blanga yu bos na, en yu garra duwit langa im.
Detlot pipul brom det kantri gulum Taya garra bringim ola presen langa yu,
en ola ritjwan pipul garra trai blanga meigim yu dum gudbala ting langa olabat.
Det gel weya garra merrit langa det king, im kaminap langa det bigwan haus.
Im brabli purdiwan.
Blanga im dres deibin meigim garram golwan kotin.
Im werrimbat brabli purdiwan klos,
en dei deigim im langa det king,
en ola yanggel hu oldei album im du.
Olabat bulurrum im olawei biyain blanga go langa det king.
Brabli gudbinjiwei dei kaman en gowin langa det bigwan haus blanga det king.
Main king, yu garra abum detmatj san na blanga jidan ola king jis laik yu femili bin jidan bifo.
En yu garra meigim olabat jidan boswan langa ebri kantri langa dijan wel.
Main song garra meigim yu neim jidan haibala olagijawan,
en ebribodi garra preisimbat yu olagijawan.
